capabilities: Embed .json Lottie animations in notes using image embed syntax
Paste animation JSON into lottie code blocks
Open .json files full-pane with a seek bar and frame stepping
Pause and resume animations from an on-screen button
Switch rendering backends between CPU, WebGL and WebGPU
extras: Animations start paused when the system is set to reduce motion; .json files only appear in the file explorer if Detect all file extensions is enabled.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Lottie animation files, so .json animations show nothing when embedded in a note.
summary: Plays Lottie animations in notes, embedded like images or opened full-pane on their own tab.
